softwareInnerHero.title: Transform Your Designs into Stunning Visuals
paragraphs: Lumion is powerful 3D rendering software that makes it easy to transform your CAD models into beautiful images, videos, and 360 panoramas. With its intuitive interface and real-time rendering capabilities, Lumion helps architects and designers communicate their vision with breathtaking visuals.

Designed for professionals who need to create high-quality visualizations quickly, Lumion seamlessly integrates with your favorite modeling software. Its vast content library and powerful effects allow you to add life, context, and emotion to your designs with just a few clicks.

Whether you’re creating architectural visualizations, urban planning projects, or landscape designs, Lumion provides the tools you need to impress clients and stakeholders with photorealistic results.

cardSections.subheading: Discover why architects worldwide choose Lumion

items.title: Real-Time Rendering
items.body: Experience the speed of real-time rendering as you make changes to your scene. See updates instantly and iterate quickly to perfect your visualization.

items.title: Stunning Visual Effects
items.body: Create photorealistic images and videos with advanced effects including volumetric lighting, atmospheric rain, and customizable materials.

items.title: Extensive Content Library
items.body: Access thousands of high-quality models, materials, and objects to bring your scenes to life. From furniture to vegetation, find everything you need.

items.title: Seamless Integration
items.body: Work with your favorite modeling software including Revit, SketchUp, ArchiCAD, Rhino, and more. Import models with LiveSync for real-time synchronization.

items.title: 360° Panoramas
items.body: Create immersive 360° panoramas that allow clients to experience your designs from every angle. Perfect for presentations and virtual walkthroughs.

items.title: Video Creation
items.body: Produce professional-quality videos with cinematic camera effects, smooth transitions, and customizable paths to tell the story of your design.
